extraction.Name: Viola Huggins Hayes
extraction.Refused/Protested: I told the man that gave it to me that I did not want it but the answer was that it had been recorded and taxes were due.
extraction.Recorded patent: it had been recorded (per statement made to allottee at time of delivery)
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I did not know the patent had been issued until I was notified from the county authorities that taxes were due; I should not have sold it had the patent not have been issued
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered by banker in Gregory at the time of sale; sold land for $4500 in cash with no debts settled and no automobiles or other articles taken in payment; has two adopted children; health is fair; satisfied with the sale but states she would not have sold had the patent not been issued; did not ask for the patent; sworn before Cjas. W. Gross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on May 2, 1929.
